newsitem.title: USA: Norland, Metra Bio, Berlex in sales pact.
newsitem.headline: Norland, Metra Bio, Berlex in sales pact.

text.p: Norland Medical Systems Inc said Monday that it is in a joint program with Metra Biosystems Inc and Berlex Laboratories Inc for the comprehensive management of post-menopausal conditions, including bone-related diseases.

Norland said that under the agreement, Berlex's Female Healthcare sales representatives will promote to U.S. obstetricians/gynecologists a product offering that includes Norland's pDEXAr and OsteoAnalyzerT bone densitometers, Metra's Pyrilinksr-D bone resorption immunoassay and Berlex's female healthcare products for the management of menopause.
